Preflight: missing (only you can do these; docs/PRODUCTION.md)
  [missing] wrangler login
      fix: npx wrangler login
  [missing] CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
      fix: add CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=<id> to .secrets/prod.env
  [missing] PV_CF_API_TOKEN
      fix: create the account API token (docs/PRODUCTION.md step 7) and add it to .secrets/prod.env
  [missing] PV_R2_CATALOG_TOKEN
      fix: create the R2 API token (docs/PRODUCTION.md step 8) and add it to .secrets/prod.env
  [missing] PV_GCP_PROJECT
      fix: add PV_GCP_PROJECT=<PROJECT_ID> to .secrets/prod.env (docs/PRODUCTION.md step 10)
  [missing] PV_ACCESS_ALLOWED_EMAILS
      fix: add the persona sign-in emails to .secrets/prod.env (docs/PRODUCTION.md step 16)
  [missing] PV_ACCESS_PERSONA_EMAILS
      fix: add email=principalId pairs to .secrets/prod.env (docs/PRODUCTION.md step 16)
  [missing] Google Cloud: gcloud
      fix: brew install --cask gcloud-cli
cloudflare: 9 step(s)
  npx wrangler r2 bucket create pv-source-exports
  npx wrangler r2 bucket create pv-derived
  npx wrangler r2 bucket create pv-lake
  npx wrangler d1 create pv-control (records database_id)
  npx wrangler kv namespace create pv-cache (records id)
  npx wrangler queues create pv-retention-sweep
  npx wrangler queues create pv-retention-dlq
  npx wrangler basin catalog enable pv-lake (records PV_CATALOG_URI and PV_CATALOG_WAREHOUSE in .secrets/prod.env)
  POST /client/v4/accounts/<ACCOUNT_ID>/ai-gateway/gateways {"id":"peoplevault","cache_ttl":0,"cache_invalidate_on_update":false,"collect_logs":false,"rate_limiting_interval":60,"rate_limiting_limit":10,"rate_limiting_technique":"fixed"}
gcp: 1 step(s)
  uv run --project pipelines pv setup gcp (idempotent; its own plan: uv run --project pipelines pv setup gcp --dry-run)
worker: 4 step(s)
  generate PV_PSEUDONYM_MASTER_KEY (32 random bytes) into .secrets/worker-secrets.env, once; copy it to your password manager
  render infra/cloudflare/wrangler.production.jsonc from the template (D1 id, KV id, ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN, ACCESS_AUD = pending-access-application until the Access application exists, GCP_PROJECT_ID, RETENTION_CRON=off)
  npx wrangler d1 migrations apply pv-control --remote -c infra/cloudflare/wrangler.production.jsonc
  npm run deploy (npx wrangler deploy -c infra/cloudflare/wrangler.production.jsonc --secrets-file .secrets/worker-secrets.env)
access: 7 step(s)
  POST /client/v4/accounts/<ACCOUNT_ID>/access/service_tokens {"name":"pv-executor","duration":"8760h"} (client id and secret into .secrets/prod.env as PV_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID_EXECUTOR / PV_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET_EXECUTOR)
  POST /client/v4/accounts/<ACCOUNT_ID>/access/service_tokens {"name":"pv-persona-hr","duration":"8760h"} (client id and secret into .secrets/prod.env as PV_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID_HR / PV_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET_HR)
  POST /client/v4/accounts/<ACCOUNT_ID>/access/service_tokens {"name":"pv-persona-manager","duration":"8760h"} (client id and secret into .secrets/prod.env as PV_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID_MANAGER / PV_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET_MANAGER)
  POST /client/v4/accounts/<ACCOUNT_ID>/access/service_tokens {"name":"pv-persona-analyst","duration":"8760h"} (client id and secret into .secrets/prod.env as PV_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID_ANALYST / PV_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET_ANALYST)
  POST /client/v4/accounts/<ACCOUNT_ID>/access/service_tokens {"name":"pv-persona-privacy","duration":"8760h"} (client id and secret into .secrets/prod.env as PV_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID_PRIVACY / PV_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET_PRIVACY)
  POST /client/v4/accounts/<ACCOUNT_ID>/access/apps (infra/cloudflare/access-app.template.json: worker destination for peoplevault, allow-owner for 0 email(s), service-tokens for 5 tokens)
  render ACCESS_AUD from the Access application into infra/cloudflare/wrangler.production.jsonc, then npm run deploy
data: 3 step(s)
  npm run seed:prod (remote D1 seed and principal mapping, 41 export objects, lake self-test and table, snapshot expiration, pv load --target prod, counts and controls)
  uv run --project pipelines pv audit export --target prod (creates the Basin Catalog table governance.audit_events and copies the audit chain)
  npx wrangler basin catalog snapshot-expiration enable pv-lake governance audit_events
github: 1 step(s) (asks first)
  gh is not logged in: run gh auth login, then setup again
